name: pstn_engine_cylinder
description: One 9x9 turbine/engine cylinder: hot TTAN wall, INSL gap, INST signal wire, a NSCN/METL/PSCN spark relay, and a 4-wide PSTN piston head independently armed to COAL (fuel-injection ctype, held near 1727C), PSNS (pressure-sense ctype) and INSL (insulation ctype). Repeat at a 28px pitch for a multi-cylinder bank.
why: Read pixel-exact from save 2396223 (Nuclear Fission Power Plant): two identical cylinder cross-sections at (226,25)-(234,34) and (226,53)-(234,62) -- exactly 28px apart -- each with PSTN@(230,y) reading temp=2000K/tmp=143/tmp2=143 (ctype=COAL) next to PSTN(ctype=PSNS) and PSTN(ctype=INSL, tmp=147), the clearest real two-piston synchronized engine found across the whole harvest (cross-save pattern #4 in mechanisms-community-2026-08-25.md). Distinct from heat_pressure_turbine_gate (same save's separate PSNS/TSNS sensor-interlock ladder at x356-388) -- this module is the physical piston cylinder itself.
source: save 2396223, x226-234 y25-34 (cylinder 1) and y53-62 (cylinder 2, identical, 28px pitch)
